scope: Engineered candidate-mediator experiment in smooth 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes, not molecular water or a new memory term. Passive tracers do not act on the fluid.
preparation: Same fresh low-mode random field, opposite signed fixed divergence-free forcing until 0.2, then unforced until 0.4. Native prediction branches preserve the resulting fields and their own tracer histories.
causal_branches: Replace both preparations' low modes by their average; equalize every high-mode vector norm to the RMS over preparations. Retained and phase-scrambled branches thus share low coefficients, energy, enstrophy and scalar power at every Fourier mode. Scrambling multiplies each high-mode vector by a conjugacy-consistent seeded unit phase, common to both preparations. Sham translates the high band only. A common complete-state replacement is an expected deterministic identity check, not primary evidence.
primary_intervention_target: Per independent seed, RMS across common fixed centers of [probe-minus-unprobed forward FTLE in + preparation] minus [that response in - preparation]. Primary contrast: retained contrast magnitude minus mean of four phase-scrambled contrast magnitudes at horizon 0.4. Positive means attenuation by scrambling; a nonnegative magnitude alone is not a null-hypothesis test.
secondary_targets: full-field difference of the paired probe responses

prediction.baseline: Present exact velocity, complete local gradient, current finite-neighbor geometry and instantaneous neighbor separation rates. Does not observe the complete Eulerian field.
prediction.history: Same baseline plus causal finite-neighbor distance/angle changes at lookbacks 0.1,0.2,0.3.
models: same current expansion plus linear histories
same plus equal-count cubic current features
prediction.selection: Training standardization; validation-only regularization selection; no test fitting. Freeze before evaluating fresh test seeds.
prediction.input_future_separation: Inputs end at intervention time 0.4; targets integrate only forward after that time. Inputs cannot access future fields or tangent matrices.

inference.unit: whole independent starting-flow seed; average phase replicates and centers within seed

refinement: All twelve test flows on all three grids at fixed dt; all twelve test flows with half dt at n=24; two test flows with half dt at n=48. CPU/GPU agreement on two pilot flows. If a gate fails, report failure and make no validated physical-effect claim; do not relax tolerances. A separately recorded amendment may add refinement.
identity_controls: Relabel/reorder marker arrays consistently and recalculate all geometric features and targets. A no-probe exact duplicate and common full-state reset must agree. Verify conjugacy, incompressibility, per-mode power and equal coarse coefficients for every erasure/sham intervention.
limits: Phase scrambling is an instantaneous externally imposed impulse. It destroys one candidate spatial phase organization but preserves polarization relationships within each mode and need not erase all history. Matched low modes and power spectra are incomplete states. Neither predictive improvement nor attenuation demonstrates a new physical memory law, learning, leadership or a heteroclinic network. Fresh seeds are not independently implemented solvers.
